blocks.text: if statement se hum condition (shart) ki base par faisla karte hain. Agar shart sach (True) ho to code ka ek block chalta hai; jhoot (False) ho to woh block chhor diya jata hai.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
Yeh if statement ki shakal (syntax) hai, poora program nahi.
"if": keyword hamesha chhote letters mein.
"condition": yahan aap ki apni shart aati hai jis ka jawab True ya False ho, maslan temperature > 30.
":": condition ke baad colon zaroori hai.
"# code to run if the condition is true": is jagah aap ka woh code aata hai jo shart True hone par chale. Yeh line 4 spaces aage (indented) honi chahiye; isi indentation se Python samajhti hai ke yeh if ke andar hai.
Shart False ho to yeh indented block chhor diya jata hai. Dhyan dein: block mein sirf comment ho to Python IndentationError deti hai; wahan kam az kam ek asli statement likhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab syntax mein "If condition:" bare I ke saath chhapti hai. Python ke keywords chhote letters mein hote hain: if condition:. Bare I se SyntaxError aata hai.
Misaal: agar temperature 30 degree se zyada ho to message print karein.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"temperature = 35": temperature variable mein 35 rakha gaya.
"if temperature > 30:": shart check hoti hai: 35 > 30 True hai.
"print("It's a hot day")": yeh line indented hai, yani if ke andar; shart True hai is liye chalti hai.
Output: It's a hot day (kitab ke text ki tarah tirchha apostrophe ’ chhapta hai).
Khud try karein: temperature = 25 kar ke Run karein: shart False hogi aur kuch bhi print nahi hoga.

Yahan temperature = 35 hai, to shart temperature > 30 sach hai aur "It’s a hot day" print hota hai. Dhyan dein: print wali line aage khiski hui (indented) hai; isi se Python samajhti hai ke yeh line if ke andar hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar temperature 25 ho to program kya print karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Kuch nahi: shart jhooti hai, to block chhor diya jata hai.

items: if shart: shart sach ho to indented block chalta hai.
Keyword hamesha chhote letters mein: if.
